title: 第1640章 奴役二第1639章 奴役
slug: 凡人修仙开局看守草药场
content_zh:
苏星河虽然痛快的发下天道誓言，却也有前提条件，就是四人不能违逆他的心意，这意味着，对方若有半点违逆，这天道誓言便不作数了。
“期限呢？”
见苏星河没了下文，帝塔皱眉询问。
“额......”
苏星河有些无语，不过，还是痛痛快快，再次起誓，将结婴后还他们自由的条件加上，至此，帝塔阴沉的脸色，终于好看了一些。
“把剑拔出去吧！”
帝塔阴沉着脸。
“不急，先将主仆契约缔结，我自然会收回长剑！”
虽然条件已经谈妥，但没有真正将帝塔收为奴仆之前，苏星河自然不会掉以轻心，要知道，眼前这位，可是几人中，实力最强的，最重要的是，他还掌握空间术法，一旦没了五行仙剑的震慑，保不齐他还会施展出逃命手段。
即便有把握对付他们三人，但苏星河却不想节外生枝，更不想因一时疏忽，再起波澜，要知道，除了眼前的四人之外，千贺宗外围，还有强者暗中把守。
“你如何缔结主仆契约？御兽那一套，可无法用在我们身上！”
帝塔虽然脸色不好看，却也不敢发作，毕竟，很快他就要成为对方的奴仆了，此时再激怒对方，显然不是明智之举。
“我既然提出了条件，自然早有准备！”
苏星河扯了扯嘴角，指尖一点魂力凝聚，正是修炼了《九幽炼魂录》后，分出的四道单独的神魂之一。
其中两道，已经分别契约了白骨真人和青山真君，此时，还有两道可以施展。
催动《尸傀炼魂录》，在身前凝聚出丈许方圆的契约铭文后，苏星河看向帝塔道：
“这是禁忌契约，入体后，会进入你的神魂深处，会有些许不适，不要反抗，否则，我无法保证你的神魂，不受损害！”
见帝塔点头，苏星河手掌迅速按在了帝塔的手臂之上。
原本，直接按在头颅之身上，才是最佳选择，毕竟，神魂海洋蕴藏在头颅，而百会穴是神魂连同肉身最近的穴道，可帝塔身高将近三丈，哪怕苏星河身高比大多数人还高一些，却也摸不到对方的头颅。
好在，帝塔不会反抗，禁忌契约顺着手臂，迅速没入他的身体，进入到他的神魂之中。

“啊~！”
就在禁忌契约没入帝塔身体的一瞬，帝塔脸上再度浮现痛苦之色，浑身也不受控制的颤抖起来。
苏星河早有准备，虽然没有收回五行仙剑，却是松开了手，长剑虽然还在帝塔体内，却是跟着他的颤抖一起抖动，所造成的伤害，可以忽略不计。
“不要反抗！这禁忌契约一旦感受到威胁，会自动爆裂，到那时，神仙难救！”
察觉到帝塔神魂中，产生些许排斥的念头，苏星河严肃提醒。
《尸傀炼魂录》中，有明确记载，一旦尸傀神魂反抗，触发契约禁忌，瞬间便会引爆，效果与修士自爆一样恐怖！
对于苏星河的提醒，帝塔没有给出任何回应，但整个人却是颤抖更厉害了，原本还有所克制的哀嚎，已经变成了惨嚎。
content_en:
Although Su Xinghe happily swore the Heavenly Dao Oath, there was a prerequisite, that is, the four of them could not disobey his will. This meant that if the other party disobeyed in the slightest, the Heavenly Dao Oath would not count.
"What about the deadline?"
Seeing that Su Xinghe had nothing to say, Di Ta frowned and asked.
"Um..."
Su Xinghe was a little speechless, but he still happily swore again and added the condition that they would be free after the baby was born. At this point, Di Ta's gloomy face finally looked better.
"Take out the sword!"
Ditta had a sullen face.
"Don't worry, sign the master-servant contract first, and I will naturally take back the sword!"
Although the conditions have been negotiated, Su Xinghe will not take it lightly until he actually takes Emperor Ta as his slave. You must know that the person in front of him is the strongest among them. The most important thing is that he also masters space magic. Once the Five Elements Sword is no longer intimidating, he will resort to escape methods.
Even though he was sure of dealing with the three of them, Su Xinghe didn't want to cause trouble, let alone cause another disturbance due to a moment of negligence. You must know that in addition to the four people in front of him, there are also strong people secretly guarding the periphery of Qianhe Sect.
"How do you conclude a master-servant contract? The method of controlling beasts cannot be used on us!"
Although Di Ta's face looked ugly, he did not dare to get angry. After all, he would soon become the slave of the other party. It was obviously not a wise move to anger the other party at this time.
"Since I have put forward the conditions, I am naturally prepared!"
Su Xinghe twitched the corner of his mouth, and gathered a little soul power on his fingertips. It was one of the four separate souls that were separated after practicing the "Nine Nether Soul Refining Record".
Two of them have been contracted to Master Baigu and True Lord Qingshan respectively. At this time, there are still two more that can be used.
After activating the "Corpse Puppet Soul Refining Record" and condensing a contract inscription about ten feet wide in front of him, Su Xinghe looked at the Imperial Pagoda and said:
"This is a taboo contract. After entering the body, it will enter the depths of your soul and you will feel a little uncomfortable. Don't resist, otherwise, I cannot guarantee that your soul will not be damaged!"
Seeing Di Ta's nod, Su Xinghe quickly pressed his palm on Di Ta's arm.
Originally, pressing directly on the head was the best choice. After all, the soul ocean is contained in the head, and Baihui point is the closest acupuncture point to the soul and the body. However, Emperor Ta is nearly three feet tall, and even though Su Xinghe is taller than most people, he still can't touch the opponent's head.
Fortunately, Di Pa would not resist. The forbidden contract followed his arm and quickly entered his body and entered his soul.
"Ah~!"
The moment the taboo contract sank into Di Ta's body, pain appeared on Di Ta's face again, and his whole body began to tremble uncontrollably.
Su Xinghe was well prepared. Although he did not take back the Five Elements Sword, he let go of his hand. Although the sword was still in the Emperor's body, it trembled with his trembling, and the damage caused was negligible.
"Don't resist! Once this forbidden contract feels threatened, it will burst automatically. By then, it will be difficult for the gods to save it!"
Sensing some repulsive thoughts in the Emperor Pagoda's soul, Su Xinghe reminded him seriously.
In "Corpse Puppet Soul Refining Record", there is a clear record that once the corpse puppet soul resists and triggers the contract taboo, it will explode instantly, and the effect is as terrifying as a monk's self-destruction!
Di Tower did not respond to Su Xinghe's reminder, but his whole body was shaking even more violently, and the originally restrained wail had turned into a howl.
